scientific_question: Does the frozen htdemucs_ft to unchanged JGA path preserve source-labelled Double Bass and Drum temporal observations from a deterministic CED-VAL-005 controlled mix at a level comparable to CED-VAL-006?

authorities.original_bass: 11_BassDI.wav only; 1138 frozen EME; BassMic is prohibited as reference

controlled_mix.population: all 16 checksum-authorized musical WAVs; exclude Readme and AppleDouble sidecars
controlled_mix.decode: exact signed 24-bit little-endian PCM to int64
controlled_mix.channel_mapping: preserve stereo; duplicate mono exactly to left and right
controlled_mix.summation: exact int64 addition in UTF-8 filename-byte lexicographic order over unchanged common sample coordinates
controlled_mix.planning: dry pass determines complete unscaled absolute peak; freeze sole coefficient 8388607/peak before WAV generation
controlled_mix.quantization: exact round-to-nearest, half away from zero
controlled_mix.replay: two independent generations must be byte-identical

jga_observation.configuration: unchanged production observation configuration; 44100 Hz; hop 512

matching.method: exact frozen CED-VAL-006 one-to-one temporal assignment independently for Bass and Drums
matching.cells: half-open original-event Voronoi cells [left,right), bounded by 0 and 10068072/44100 seconds
matching.selection: chronological originals; unused in-cell candidate with minimum absolute displacement, then earlier time, then lower native identity
matching.tolerance: Voronoi cell authority only; no correction or added tolerance

metrics: signed and absolute displacement distributions including median, RMSE, maximum

authorized_descriptive_deltas.DELTA_BASS_RECALL: CED-VAL-005 recall minus 0.5867298578199052, with relative percentage change
authorized_descriptive_deltas.DELTA_BASS_F1: CED-VAL-005 F1 minus 0.7278071722516166, with relative percentage change

outcome_gates_priority.INDETERMINATE: any authority, checksum, execution, correspondence, or replay invariant fails
outcome_gates_priority.PRESERVATION_REPLICATED_WITHIN_MARGIN: both runs Bass recall >= 0.5367298578199052 and F1 >= 0.6778071722516166; run-to-run differences <= 0.02; Drum recall >= 0.90
outcome_gates_priority.MIXED_REPLICATION: Bass recall or F1 satisfies its margin but not both in both runs, or Drum recall < 0.90
outcome_gates_priority.LOWER_BASS_PRESERVATION: both runs fall below both Bass margins
outcome_gates_priority.INDETERMINATE_CROSS_RUN_VARIABILITY: run-to-run Bass recall or F1 differs by more than 0.02

interpretation_firewall: Separate genre/material, recording/acquisition, separation, and JGA observation. No physical-onset, causal genre/swing/walking-bass/kick/recording/instrumentation, production-fitness, or universal-generalization claim.
